app.name: Rumbo
app.tagline: The route comes alive when you arrive.

lang.title: Choose your language
lang.hint: You can change it later in Settings.

slide1.title: Pick a route
slide1.body: Walks around the city and out in nature, ready to explore at your own pace.

slide2.title: Walk: we'll tell you when you arrive
slide2.body: Keep your phone in your pocket. It buzzes and chimes at every stop.

slide3.title: Every place comes alive
slide3.body: Stories, fun facts and the odd challenge at each stop.

consent.title: Anonymous statistics
consent.body: Help us improve with anonymous statistics. We never store your location.

ios.install: Install Rumbo to get alerts when you arrive
ios.steps: Tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.

explore.offline: You're offline. Here are your downloaded routes.

empty.title: No routes in this area yet
empty.body: Pick the places you want to see and we'll put the guide together for you.

rules.challenge: Fixed order · Limit {time} · Pass all {n} checkpoints

prepare.title: Before you start
prepare.intro: Then you can keep your phone in your pocket: we'll let you know when you reach each place.

location.title: Location
location.body: So we know when you reach each place.
location.denied: Location is blocked. Turn it on in your browser's settings for this site and try again.
location.simulated: Simulation mode: your real location isn't needed.

notifications.title: Alerts
notifications.body: We'll alert you even when the app is minimised.

sound.title: Sound and vibration
sound.body: Check that you can hear the arrival alert.

wakeLock.title: Screen on
wakeLock.body: Location only works while the screen is on.
wakeLock.unsupported: This browser can't keep it on: tap it now and then.

prepare.ready: All set. Pocket your phone and walk.

gps.weak: Weak GPS signal. Move to an open space.

comingSoon.title: Coming soon
comingSoon.body: You'll be able to see this place in 3D here.

PERMISSION_DENIED.title: Location is blocked
PERMISSION_DENIED.body: Without your location we can't tell when you arrive. Turn it on in your browser's settings for this site and tap Try again.

POSITION_UNAVAILABLE.title: We can't find your position
POSITION_UNAVAILABLE.body: Move to an open space and check that location is on on your phone.

TIMEOUT.title: Location is taking too long
TIMEOUT.body: Check that location is on on your phone and try again.

UNSUPPORTED.title: This browser doesn't share your location
UNSUPPORTED.body: Open Rumbo in an up-to-date Chrome or Safari, or use simulation mode.

idle.title: Still there?
idle.body: You've been in the same spot for {minutes} min.

outOfOrder.title: This isn't the next stop
outOfOrder.body: First you need to go to {name}.

timeout.title: Time's up
timeout.body: You can carry on without the official clock.

pause.title: Paused
pause.body: The clock is stopped. We won't alert you when you arrive.

confirm.title: End the route?
confirm.body: We'll keep what you've done so far.

summary.subtitle: {route} · {when}
summary.none: You haven't finished a route yet.

recover.title: You have a route in progress
recover.changed: This route has been updated. Start again to see the changes.

redirect.title: You're about to open an external website

myRoutes.title: My routes

empty.title: Create your first route
empty.body: Pick the places you want to see and we'll prepare a guide that comes alive when you arrive.

myRoutes.deleteBody: It will be deleted from this device and the server. This can't be undone.
myRoutes.loadError: We can't read your routes on this device.
myRoutes.activeRunEdit: You have this route in progress: it will keep the previous version.
myRoutes.activeRunDelete: You have this route in progress. Deleting it will end it.

sync.pending: Only on this device · uploads when you're online
sync.invalid: The server rejected the route. Edit it and save it again.
sync.quota: You've reached the maximum number of routes on the server.

draft.discardBody: The details and places you added will be lost.
draft.replaceBody: If you edit this route, the draft will be discarded.
draft.storageOff: We can't save your draft on this device.

details.name: Route name
details.areaHint: Centres the map and searches nearby.

mode.free: Visit at your own pace, in any order
mode.challenge: Fixed order, checkpoints and a timer

search.noResults: We couldn't find “{q}” nearby. Try another name or press and hold the map.
search.offline: You're offline: we can't search for places now.
search.offlineMap: Offline: press and hold the map to add places.

places.empty: Search for a place or press and hold the map
places.emptyNoMap: Search for a place to add it to the route.
places.mapUnavailable: The map isn't available right now.
places.overlapHint: Reduce their radius (20 m minimum) or remove one of them.
places.name: Place name
places.radiusHint: Entering this circle counts as arriving.
places.requiredHint: It must be visited to complete the route.

review.addressesOk: Each place shows a card with its name and address
review.noAddress: {n} place without an address: its card will show only the name | {n} places without an address: their cards will show only the name
review.timeLimitShort: The time limit ({limit}) is shorter than the estimated duration ({estimate}).
review.invalid: The route has errors: check the previous steps.
review.testHint: You walk it in simulation; nothing is saved.
review.saveError: We couldn't save the route on this device.

trial.activeTitle: You have a route in progress
trial.activeBody: We'll pause it to test this route; you can continue it later.

done.title: Your route is ready
done.synced: Saved. You can walk it whenever you like.
done.local: Saved on this device. We'll upload it when you're back online.

errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

settings.title: Settings

sol.label: “Sol” high contrast
sol.hint: More contrast and larger text for bright sunlight.

language.label: Language
language.hint: Cards already generated with AI stay in their language.

clearData.body: Your settings, saved routes in progress, downloaded routes and the routes you created will be removed from this device.

clearData.routesLost: {n} route you created hasn't been uploaded yet and will be lost. | {n} routes you created haven't been uploaded yet and will be lost.

simulation.label: Simulation mode
simulation.hint: For demos: your location is simulated and shown in purple.
